description: The Ballybrack Beach Walk is a scenic coastal path located in Moville, County Donegal. This approximately 2.2-kilometer (one-way) trail begins at Moville's shorefront and extends along the coastline towards Ballybrack, nearly reaching Greencastle. The route offers walkers picturesque views of Lough Foyle and the surrounding landscapes. The path is well-maintained and suitable for various fitness levels, making it ideal for leisurely strolls and pet walking. Along the way, visitors can enjoy the tranquil ambiance of the shoreline, with opportunities to observe local wildlife and the natural beauty of the area. The beach itself features a mix of stones and sandy areas, adding to its unique charm. This walk provides a peaceful retreat for those looking to experience the serene coastal environment of County Donegal. You can extend the walk on the Moville Shore Walk .
